name: Malen'kie tragedii
source: Sometimes in life, there are small tragedies. Sometimes, many small tragedies turn into a big one, and all that's left is to sit down on the ground and cry. Sometimes there's no strength left to endure everything alone...
translation: Sometimes in life, there are small tragedies. Sometimes, many small tragedies turn into a big one, and all that's left is to sit down on the ground and cry. Sometimes there's no strength left to endure everything alone...
